notes: This dataset contains intermediate data products for some experiments in the PhD thesis "Learned infinite elements for helioseismology" (J.Preuß) which compare different models for the solar atmosphere. A brief description of the provided data is given below: The files "power-spectrum-VALC-meshed.out" and "power-spectrum-Atmo-whitw.out" contain the power spectrum computed with a meshed VAL-C atmosphere and with the exact Atmo condition obtained by evaluating the Whittaker function, respectively. Harmonic degrees up to l=1000 and 7200 equidistant frequencies ranging from 0.0 mHz up to 8.3 mHz have been computed. The files "dtn_nr_VALC_intro.out" and "dtn_nr_Whitw_intro.out" contain the corresponding Dirichlet-to-Neumann numbers (for the Atmo model taken about 500km above the photosphere and for the VAL-C model directly at the photosphere). The file "mdi_medium_l.np" is a reference power spectrum obtained from satellite observations (HMI). Please see here for the corresponding publication. A description how the computed data has been obtained and how it should be postprocessed further is available at this Gitlab repository.
